_comment: Custom kernel sources for Mahirooo's builder. 'repo'/'branch' is where the actual kernel/common source is pulled from (overrides the stock AOSP kernel/common after repo sync). 'manifest_sublevel'/'manifest_os_patch_level' only pin which AOSP manifest branch is used to fetch matching build tooling (clang toolchain, kernel/build scripts, bazel setup) for that kernel family - they do NOT affect which kernel source is built.
